title: Parallel Goals
hook: Your goals aren't fighting for your time. They're fighting for the same slot on your calendar.
statement: Chase goals that fit together, so one action can move two of them at once.
explainer: Most goals need their own attention, not their own hours. A walk with a client builds the relationship and gets your steps in. That's not cutting corners, that's stacking smart.
sop: List your active goals across business, health, relationships, and learning.
Find one action that genuinely serves two goals at once.
Count the Total Outputs each action produces.
Schedule that double-duty action and name both goals it serves.
Check monthly that it's still serving both, not just one.
equation_example: A walk with a client gives you 2 outputs, relationship and exercise, from 1 action. 2 ÷ 1 = 2.0 Leverage. A separate call plus a separate workout is 2 ÷ 2 = 1.0. Higher means more goals moving per action. 1.0 means they're competing for your hours.
question: Pick two goals for this week and write down one action that moves both.
closing_statement: One well-designed action can quietly serve two goals.
caption:
Principle Nº 235: Parallel Goals

Your goals aren't fighting for your time. They're fighting for the same slot on your calendar.

Chase goals that fit together, so one action can move two of them at once.

Your turn: Pick two goals for this week and write down one action that moves both.
